exact_formula: Count quantized note starts t with 0<=t<8
undefined_policy: Always defined; zero for no onsets

exact_formula: Length of union of clipped note intervals intersecting [0;8) divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined; zero for no active notes

exact_formula: Minimum quantized onset in [0;8); 8 when there is no onset
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Number of distinct quantized onset positions carrying more than one note divided by number of nonempty onset positions
undefined_policy: NaN when there is no onset

exact_formula: Number of 0.25-beat cells overlapped by more than one active note divided by 32
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Maximum quantized Melody note end measured from MIDI beat zero
undefined_policy: Zero when there are no notes

exact_formula: Number of note starts in [0;8) divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Number of distinct quantized onset positions in [0;8) divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Maximum note-start count in any 4-beat window stepped by 0.25 beat divided by 4
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Maximum note-start count in any 8-beat window stepped by 0.25 beat divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Median and 10th/90th percentiles of positive differences between successive distinct quantized onsets plus population SD divided by mean
undefined_policy: NaN with fewer than two distinct onsets; CV also NaN for nonpositive mean

exact_formula: Median and 10th/90th percentiles of note durations clipped to [0;8) plus population SD divided by mean
undefined_policy: NaN with no overlapping notes; CV also NaN for nonpositive mean

exact_formula: Fraction of clipped note durations less than or equal to 0.25 beat
undefined_policy: NaN with no overlapping notes

exact_formula: Length of union of clipped note intervals intersecting [0;8) divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Number of integer beat cells in [0;8) with no active note overlap divided by 8
undefined_policy: Always defined

exact_formula: Maximum gap after adding window edges 0 and 8 to distinct onset positions
undefined_policy: Equals 8 with no onset

exact_formula: Max-minus-min; p95-minus-p05; median; and population SD of pitches starting in [0;8)
undefined_policy: NaN with no onset notes

exact_formula: Median and p90 of absolute intervals between median pitches at successive onset positions plus fractions strictly over 7 and 12 semitones
undefined_policy: NaN with fewer than two distinct onsets; leap rates are descriptive only

exact_formula: Shannon entropy of duration-weighted pitch-class probabilities after clipping divided by log(12)
undefined_policy: NaN with zero active duration

exact_formula: Shannon entropy of distinct onset counts over four 0.25-beat phases divided by log(4)
undefined_policy: NaN with no onset

exact_formula: Same formula as corresponding first8 metric with window [0;full_horizon_beats)
undefined_policy: Same condition as corresponding first8 metric; all NaN if Melody is empty

exact_formula: Absolute natural log of ((first8 onset density+1e-8)/(full onset density+1e-8))
undefined_policy: NaN if either source value is undefined

exact_formula: Absolute natural log of ((first8 median duration+1e-8)/(full median duration+1e-8))
undefined_policy: NaN if either median is undefined

exact_formula: Absolute first8 robust pitch range minus full robust pitch range
undefined_policy: NaN if either range is undefined

exact_formula: Jensen-Shannon divergence between first8 and full duration-weighted pitch-class distributions divided by log(2)
undefined_policy: NaN if either distribution has zero mass

exact_formula: Jensen-Shannon divergence between first8 and full four-phase distinct-onset distributions divided by log(2)
undefined_policy: NaN if either distribution has zero mass

exact_formula: One when an exactly named Accompaniment track exists; zero for a valid Melody-only empty prompt
undefined_policy: Blank only for missing invalid or ambiguous prompt MIDI

exact_formula: Count accompaniment note starts in [0;8)
undefined_policy: Zero for empty prompt

exact_formula: Prompt note starts and distinct quantized prompt onset positions in [0;8) divided by 8
undefined_policy: Zero for empty prompt

exact_formula: Union duration divided by 8 and fraction of eight integer beat cells without active prompt overlap
undefined_policy: For empty prompt active coverage is zero and empty beat rate is one

exact_formula: Median/p10/p90/CV of prompt intervals clipped to [0;8) and fraction of durations <=0.25 beat
undefined_policy: NaN for empty prompt

exact_formula: Max-minus-min; p95-minus-p05; and median of pitches whose notes start in [0;8)
undefined_policy: NaN for empty prompt

exact_formula: Duration-weighted prompt pitch-class Shannon entropy divided by log(12)
undefined_policy: NaN for empty prompt

exact_formula: Distinct prompt-onset four-phase Shannon entropy divided by log(4)
undefined_policy: NaN for empty prompt

exact_formula: Mean count of active prompt notes over 32 quantized 0.25-beat cells
undefined_policy: Zero for empty prompt

exact_formula: Jaccard similarity of binary 16-step onset vectors for beats [0;4) and [4;8)
undefined_policy: NaN when both bars contain no onset

exact_formula: Natural log of ((prompt onset density+1e-8)/(Melody onset density+1e-8)) and its absolute value
undefined_policy: NaN if either density is undefined

exact_formula: Absolute natural log of ((prompt median duration+1e-8)/(Melody median duration+1e-8))
undefined_policy: NaN if either median duration is undefined

exact_formula: Normalized Jensen-Shannon divergence between Melody and prompt duration-weighted pitch-class distributions
undefined_policy: NaN if either distribution has zero mass

exact_formula: Normalized Jensen-Shannon divergence between Melody and prompt four-phase distinct-onset distributions
undefined_policy: NaN if either distribution has zero mass

exact_formula: Absolute difference between prompt and Melody median MIDI pitch
undefined_policy: NaN if either track has no onset note
